chain.title: Pull It Up And Run
chain.desc: Mandrakes are the mod's one real mob - a crop that gets up and screams. Their loot table gives mandrake_root and mandrake_seeds, and the root is in more recipes than anything else here.

chain.title: The Root
chain.desc: Mandrake root is the single most-used reagent in the mod. Brews, poppets, golden chalk and the drop of luck all want it.

chain.title: Plant The Nightshade
chain.desc: Belladonna, mandrake, snowbell, wolfsbane and water artichoke are the five crops. Note the ITEM is belladonna_flower - the id belladonna is only the crop BLOCK and has no item form.

chain.title: The Oven
chain.desc: Smelting anything in the witch oven produces a byproduct as well as the normal output. That is a whole custom recipe type - enchanted:byproduct, nine of them - and it is how you get fume and ash.

chain.title: Ash
chain.desc: The byproduct of burning logs in the oven. Ash is the base of the chalk line and the reason the oven comes first.

chain.title: Fume
chain.desc: The byproduct of cooking meat. Foul fume feeds the distillery, and a fume funnel with a filter on the oven lets you collect it properly.

chain.title: Shape A Jar
chain.desc: Clay in a jar shape. It has to be fired before it holds anything.

chain.title: Fire The Jar
chain.desc: Smelt the soft jar. Every distilling recipe in the mod consumes a clay jar, so this is a consumable you will make hundreds of.

chain.title: The Cauldron
chain.desc: The witch cauldron runs its own recipe type - ten of them - and is where the first real potions come from. It also cooks ordinary food, which is a nice touch.

chain.title: The Altar
chain.desc: The altar stores magical power drawn from the blocks around it. data/enchanted/enchanted/altar/blocks defines what counts, and every machine in the mod draws on it.

chain.title: A Whiff Of Magic
chain.desc: The first distilled reagent. Distilling is another custom type and its recipes output through a plural results array rather than a singular result.

chain.title: The Attuned Stone
chain.desc: A whiff of magic, a diamond and a lava bucket. The attuned stone is the mod's central component - the chalice, candelabra, distillery, fume filter, circle talisman and infused poppet all need one.

chain.title: The Distillery
chain.desc: Attuned stone, a clay jar, gold nuggets and iron. Eight distilling recipes exist and they are how the rarer reagents are made.

chain.title: The Kettle
chain.desc: The kettle brews the mod's ten named brews, from the brew of love to the brew of the grotesque.

chain.title: Filter The Fumes
chain.desc: Attuned stone, glass and iron. Combined with a fume funnel it captures oven byproducts instead of letting them escape.

chain.title: The Chalice
chain.desc: Attuned stone and gold. The chalice holds blood and is one of two altar-adjacent blocks the rites care about.

chain.title: The Candelabra
chain.desc: Attuned stone, candles and iron. Altar upgrades are defined in data/enchanted/enchanted/altar/upgrades and this is one of them.

chain.title: The Wheel
chain.desc: The spinning wheel runs the largest custom recipe type in the mod - THIRTY enchanted:wheel recipes - and every poppet is made on it.

chain.title: The First Poppet
chain.desc: Poppets take a death for you. There are ten kinds, in three grades - plain, sturdy and infused - which is thirty ids, and it is the biggest single family here.

chain.title: Infused
chain.desc: Attuned stone, a poppet and an ender pearl on the wheel. Infused is the top grade and each of the ten types has one.

chain.title: A Needle
chain.desc: A bone and a flint. The needle makes the taglock kit and the voodoo protection poppet.

chain.title: The Kit
chain.desc: The taglock kit is craftable; the TAGLOCK itself is not. You use the kit on a player or mob and it fills with their identity - which is why no recipe produces a taglock and why every curse rite consumes one.

chain.title: Draw The Circle
chain.desc: Chalk marks the circles rites are cast in. Four chalks exist - ritual, golden, nether and otherwhere - and the shapes are defined in data/enchanted/enchanted/circle_magic/shape.

chain.title: The Second Chalk
chain.desc: Mandrake root, ritual chalk and a gold nugget in the witch cauldron. Bigger circles need better chalk.

chain.title: The Talisman
chain.desc: Attuned stone and gold. The talisman stores a drawn circle so you can carry it, and it has SIXTY-FOUR model states depending on which chalks are bound into it.

chain.title: A Waystone
chain.desc: The plain waystone is the input to the rite that makes a bound one.

chain.title: Bound To A Place
chain.desc: Created by the 'waystone' rite through a location_bound_create_item factory - not by any recipe. A second rite duplicates it once you have one.

chain.title: Charged
chain.desc: The charging_stone rite turns an attuned stone into a charged one. It is referenced sixteen times across the rite files and half the advanced rites demand it.

chain.title: A Broom
chain.desc: An ordinary broom, and the base of the only vehicle in the mod.

chain.title: Ointment
chain.desc: Belladonna flower, redstone soup, wool of bat, a diamond, a feather and a potion in the kettle. Six ingredients, and the broom needs it.

chain.title: Fly It
chain.desc: The infusion_broom rite consumes a broom and flying ointment inside a small and a medium chalk circle at 3000 power, and creates the broomstick. No recipe file makes this - only the rite.

notes: THE TALISMAN TRAP - 63 FAKE IDS FROM ONE ITEM. assets/enchanted/models/item contains circle_talisman_0_0_1 through circle_talisman_3_3_3, a full 4x4x4 grid of model permutations minus the base, for the SINGLE item enchanted:circle_talisman. They encode which of the four chalk types is bound into each of the three circle sizes. Every one has zero references anywhere in data/. A model-stem-only id derivation invents 63 quest targets that do not exist; that is 41 percent of this mod's real item count. This is the same class of trap as arphex's sixteen crawling_compass models and cobblemon's thirty *_ball_model files, but far larger, and it is why model stems must always be intersected with lang keys. LOADER: META-INF/mods.toml, modId enchanted, 1.20.1 Forge. Modrinth slug is enchanted. FOUR CUSTOM RECIPE TYPES AND A FIFTH SYSTEM. Beyond 34 crafting_shaped, 13 crafting_shapeless and 2 smelting, this mod ships enchanted:wheel (30 recipes, the spinning wheel - every poppet), enchanted:kettle (10, the brews), enchanted:witch_cauldron (10), enchanted:byproduct (9 - the witch oven's second output when smelting) and enchanted:distilling (8). All of them use a singular "result" EXCEPT enchanted:distilling, which uses a plural "results" array like Create's recipes do - so a scanner reading only "result" loses the eight distilling outputs. On top of that sits an entirely separate system: data/enchanted/enchanted/circle_magic/rite holds 45 RITE definitions and circle_magic/shape holds 3 circle shapes. Rites are not recipes and live nowhere near data/enchanted/recipes/. Each has an items array (consumed), a shapes map (which chalk in which circle), a power cost, and a factory that does the work. Twenty-one distinct factory types exist and four of them create items: enchanted:create_item, enchanted:duplicate_item, enchanted:location_bound_create_item and enchanted:entity_bound_create_item. VERIFICATION, TWO PASSES: pass A took the 217 assets/enchanted/models/item stems INTERSECT the item./block. lang keys and gave 154. Pass B independently rebuilt from recipe results, loot-table entry names, blockstates and lang keys and gave 224. All 70 differences resolved: 63 are the circle_talisman model grid; belladonna, mandrake, snowbell and wolfsbane are the CROP BLOCKS (blockstate plus block. lang key, no item) whose item forms are belladonna_flower, mandrake_root/mandrake_seeds, snowbell_seeds and wolfsbane_flower - a clean case of the block and the item having different names; protection_barrier and protection_barrier_temporary are rite-placed barrier blocks with no item form and zero data references; demon_heart is a lang key with no model. Final count stays 154, no widening. OBTAINABILITY: after the distilling fix, twelve pass-A ids have no recipe and no loot table, and the rite files resolve five of them. enchanted:enchanted_broomstick is created by the infusion_broom rite (create_item factory, consuming a broom and flying ointment at 3000 power). enchanted:attuned_stone_charged is created by the charging_stone rite. enchanted:bound_waystone is created by the waystone and waystone_charged rites through a location_bound_create_item factory, and duplicated by two more. enchanted:blooded_waystone is created by waystone_blooded through entity_bound_create_item. enchanted:taglock has NO producer anywhere - but enchanted:taglock_kit does (bone needle, with its own recipe advancement), and every curse and remove-curse rite consumes a taglock; the kit is used on a living target to fill it, which is a code-level interaction and a real source. All five are kept, with the mechanism spelled out in their step text. DROPPED AS UNCOMPLETABLE, 6 ids: enchanted:condensed_fear, enchanted:focused_will, enchanted:ghost_of_the_light, enchanted:infernal_animus and enchanted:mellifluous_hunger each have an item model and a lang key and ZERO references anywhere in the jar - no recipe, no rite, no loot, no tag; they are unreleased spirit-type reagents. enchanted:infinity_egg appears only in data/enchanted/enchanted/altar/upgrades/infinity_egg.json with power 99999 and recharge 99999, which is a creative/debug altar upgrade rather than a survival item. enchanted:ent_twig is also dropped: the forest rite CONSUMES it and nothing anywhere produces it. None of the seven is in the chain or any wheel. That leaves 147 obtainable ids. ENTITIES: five entity.enchanted.* lang keys - broomstick, familiar_cat, mandrake, throwable_brew and voodoo_item - but only MANDRAKE has a loot table, so it is the only honest kill: target and it is the one used. broomstick is the ridden broom, throwable_brew and voodoo_item are projectiles, and familiar_cat is bound by the bind_familiar rite rather than killed. The mod also injects into three vanilla mobs through loot_tables/extensions/entities: bats drop wool_of_bat, creepers drop creeper_heart, wolves drop tongue_of_dog - three reagents that look uncraftable until you find that directory. CONSENSUS: moddb.json lists 24 enchanted ids and all 24 resolve in this jar. No conflict with the graph. DESIRABILITY: three full wood sets (rowan, alder, hawthorn) account for 33 of the 154 ids; their slabs, stairs, fences, buttons, pressure plates and stripped logs are kept out of the spine and only the logs, planks, saplings and leaves appear, in a single wood wheel.
